procedure.en: With the grinder running, turn the collar finer until you hear a light chirping sound: that is where the burrs make contact. That point is your zero; count marks coarser from there. The printed 0 is not the zero, and two grinders will not share the same number.
procedure.pt-BR: Com o moedor ligado, gire o anel para o fino até ouvir um leve chiado: é onde as mós se tocam. Esse ponto é o seu zero; conte as marcas para o grosso a partir dali. O 0 impresso não é o zero, e dois moedores não terão o mesmo número.

notes: Stepless collar printed 0–90; values are marks from your own chirp zero, not from the printed 0. No DF Grinders chart for the DF54 in the source; the retailer guide is Grind Logic (grindlogic.com.au/blogs/articles/df54-coffee-grinder-grind-settings), kept in the band notes. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 8.8 µm per mark ((900 − 110) ÷ 90), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Zero procedure: grindlogic.com.au/blogs/articles/how-to-dial-in-df54-df64-gen-2-espresso. DF Grinders page: dfgrinders.ca/pages/df54-grind-size-guide.
